metadata.method: Seeded simulation: growing monthly volume; higher rain and peak utilization increase late deliveries; express promises are shorter and prices higher; weight and distance increase cost; delay and incidents lower ratings. Partner differences are assumptions, not claims about real carriers. Pearson correlation describes association, not causation. All resolved dates precede 2026-10-16.

definitions.order_id: Unique synthetic order identifier; no real customer data
definitions.order_date: Order date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD, UTC calendar
definitions.delivered_date: Delivery or return resolution date, order_date + actual_days
definitions.partner: Demo carrier label; no evidence of real carrier performance
definitions.distance_km: Approximate simulated route distance in km
definitions.order_value_inr: Synthetic merchandise value, INR; not Parcelwise revenue
definitions.savings_inr: Opening quote minus negotiated shipping charge, INR
definitions.promised_days: Promised delivery duration in calendar days
definitions.actual_days: Actual simulated resolution duration in calendar days
definitions.on_time: 1 if outcome Delivered and actual_days <= promised_days; otherwise 0. Dashboard OTD denominator is Delivered orders only.
definitions.outcome: Delivered, Returned or Damaged; mutually exclusive terminal outcomes
definitions.rating: Synthetic 1–5 customer score; blank if no review. Average excludes blanks.
definitions.source: Always Synthetic; never mixed with actual demo statistics
